plan: Baseline: tests (12) and acceptance (8) all pass.
Contracts: low_stock consumes Inventory.items() — tested end to end, including that the inventory is not mutated.
Integration: add/remove/low_stock flow with normalisation, zero-stock SKUs and tie ordering (qa/test_qa_flows.py).

Edge cases: non-string SKU, None/NaN/float/list qty, huge ints, exact removal, then a further removal fails, threshold 0 or negative, empty inventory, state unchanged after validation errors. All pass.

gaps: Non-int threshold passed to low_stock is unspecified in the architecture, so it is not tested.

advisory.problem: AC-003 and AC-002 are checked only on a few paths. For example, add with a bad qty on an unknown SKU is not tested, and ValueError for a bad qty is not shown to be raised before the InsufficientStock check. advisory.evidence: Every wrong implementation I tried fails at least one assertion. This is a minor gap only: a bad qty combined with qty greater than stock is never exercised.
